title: Whether 'Endia' may be used as the series title and as endia.de: trademark, title protection and domain clearance
question: What do German and EU trademark and title-protection law and the relevant registers establish about using 'Endia' as the title of the trilogy and as the domain of its official website — protection of work titles under § 5 MarkenG and the practice of Titelschutzanzeiger notices, existing registered marks in the Nice classes relevant to books and online content (9, 16, 41) at DPMA and EUIPO, and the domain-dispute rules (DENIC DIS for .de, UDRP) — and what does that require of the site's branding, any coexistence or licensing steps, and the way the site names the series?
why_now: The repository and planned site are named endia.de and README.md presents the project as the official web presence of the series; a conflict discovered after launch would force rebranding of the domain, the series title and every ecosystem reference that points here.
real_world_anchor: German/EU trademark and work-title law, the DPMA and EUIPO registers, Titelschutzanzeiger practice, and DENIC DIS / UDRP domain-dispute rules.
novelty_reason: The queued legal topics cover quotation and reuse of the novels (RES-20261015-00F9F49D), provider/press duties and advertising labelling, and youth protection (RES-20260918-C5EDAF53); none examines whether the series name and the endia.de domain may lawfully be used at all, which is a distinct pre-launch clearance question.
